resources.string: Permission granted. You can now select this app as your screen saver in system settings.
To display active media sessions, notification icons and counts on your screensaver, MediaScreenSaver requires Notification Access.

Data Accessed & Used:
• App icons and package names of active notifications
• Active notification counts
• Media session information

Privacy & Safety:
• Notification text and message contents are NEVER read, stored, or processed.
• All data is processed locally on your device in real-time.
• NO notification data is ever collected or transmitted off your device as this app does not have permission to access the internet.
In the settings find \"MediaScreenSaver\" and click on \""Allow notification access\"
